narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -9.37 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 2.169-2.251 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 2.267; the first objective pays 1.37R at 2.146.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 2.267 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.37 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 38/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $114k -3.8% below · short liq $32k +3.6% above

funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
